summary: Treat Function(...) / new Function(...) as unsupported without a JavaScript parser/compiler/runtime because it dynamically parses and executes source text.

target.notes: This is eval-like dynamic code generation. A future full JS runtime fallback may support it, but static C# lowering cannot preserve arbitrary runtime-provided source.

semantics.scope: created function uses global environment rather than caller lexical scope
semantics.parsing: parameter strings and body are parsed at runtime
semantics.call_and_new: Function(...) and new Function(...) are equivalent for creation

caveats: Constant source could theoretically be pre-parsed as a separate optimization, but must preserve global-scope semantics and toString source.
Never execute untrusted strings during compilation.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification Function Constructor / CreateDynamicFunction

tests.name: dynamic body
tests.expected_behavior: unsupported unless a JS runtime/dynamic compiler fallback is enabled
